title: ?author= filter is exact-match only
evidence: book_api.cpp:189 uses SQL `WHERE author = ?` (equality), not LIKE/substring
suggestion: Acceptable per spec; note that partial-name queries will not match

title: year validation stricter than spec (integers 0-9999, rejects floats/booleans)
evidence: book_api.cpp:88,141 reject decimals/exponents and out-of-range years with 400

title: Unsupported method on a valid resource returns 404, not 405
evidence: book_api.cpp:236 falls through to 404 'route not found'; reason_phrase(405) at line 240 is defined but never emitted by handle()
suggestion: Optionally return 405 Method Not Allowed for known paths with unsupported verbs

title: Tests are one CTest target with 9 assertions rather than discrete named cases
evidence: tests.cpp:10-36 is a single main() with assert()s for health/create/validation/get/filter/update/delete; CMakeLists.txt:21 registers one test
suggestion: Meets the >=3-tests bar via assertions; splitting into named cases would localize failures
